text_block_list.text:
One day, I accompanied Air Groove during 
her independent dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four. One, two, three, 
four!

Air Groove's dance was polished to a level 
of perfection worthy of her reputation, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —You look like you have something to say.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you have something on your mind, speak 
up. Surely you are not too timid to say a 
word?

It seemed she saw right through me and 
knew I was troubled about something.
choice_data_list:
You can definitely be more powerful than 
this.

We should be able to refine it even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ho? You've got quite the mouth on you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let me hear it. Your opinion, 
that is.

I explained to Air Groove the parts where 
she could make her expressions more 
powerful and striking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. What you're trying to say makes 
sense.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Fool! It's too early to let your guard 
down!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your duty isn't finished until I put it 
into practice and you verify the results.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Then, watch closely.

That day's practice proved fulfilling, 
breathing a new sense of power into her 
dancing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Refinement," you say? Quite a lofty term 
to throw around so casually.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Continue with the details. For you to say 
that much, you must have a plan, correct?

I explained to Air Groove the parts where 
she could make her expressions more 
delicate and flowing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. I understand the vision you're 
picturing. Well, as far as ideas go, it's 
not bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Fool! It is far too early for you to be 
satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I shall now put into practice what you 
have stated. Watch, and offer your 
feedback on any shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is your duty to see it through until 
improvements are made. Do not let your 
guard down.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Then watch from right there.

That day's practice proved fulfilling, 
bringing even greater depth and breadth to 
her expression.
